full_judgment: 3. Facts relevant for disposal of the Rule, in brief, are that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.23 of 2009 in the Court of Senior Assistant judge, Court No.1, Narayangonj praying for declaration of title in the suit land. They prayed that RS khatian was prepared erroneously in the name of the predecessor of the defendants. The defendants contested the said suit denying the statements made in the plaint. However, the trial Court after trial decreed the suit on 8-4-2012. Against which the defendants preferred Title Appeal No.94 of 2012 before the District Judge, Narayangonj. The appeal was subsequently transferred to the Court of Joint District Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Narayangonj for disposal_ The Appellate Court allowed the appeal and sent the suit to the trial Court on remand with some directions and observations. Against which the plaintiffs approached this Court in Civil Revision No.106 of 2014_ This Court upon hearing made the Rule absolute on 27-5-2015 with direction to dispose of the appeal on merit by the Appellate Court with liberty to the parties to adduce evidence, if required.
